headline: Healthy Growth Momentum Continues

highlights: However, EBITDA margin declined by 269bps YoY to 18.2% due to higher input cost, despite calibrated price increases partly offsetting the impact.
The management remains focussed on expanding Wembley’s pan- India presence, strengthening distribution and driving margin recovery.
We anticipate a gradual improvement in earnings, as pricing actions flow through in H2FY27E.
We forecast SIRCA’s Revenue/EBITDA/PAT to respectively expand at 20.8% / 21.7% / 25.2% CAGR over FY26–29E.
valuation: Valuation & View We retain our 'BUY' rating on SIRCA, valuing the company on a P/E-based framework: we apply a target multiple of 32.0x on FY28E core EPS of INR 17.5/share to arrive at a target price of INR 560/share (maintained).
watch: Key Risks A possible slowdown in the real estate market, furniture, renovation, interior fit- outs and probable predatory pricing could affect SIRCA’s business.
